description: Agent Travel: submit the passenger details on a booking with the traveler’s own records: the traveler with the name on their ID (given, middle and family, or one line), the date of birth on the ID, the current email and phone, when the contact details were last confirmed, each loyalty number with its program and the known-traveler number; the passenger on the booking with the same name parts, date of birth, email, phone, loyalty numbers and known-traveler number; and optionally the carrier with its name, its loyalty program and whether it needs a date of birth on the booking. The signed report gives each name part on the ID beside the booking with whether it matches and whether the given and family names sit in each other’s fields, the date of birth on each side with whether the carrier needs it, each contact field on record beside the booking, and every loyalty program and the known-traveler number present or absent on each side, and counts them, and names mismatched passenger details: a family or given name spelled differently from the ID, names swapped between fields, a date of birth that differs from the ID and a date of birth missing where the carrier needs one; then a middle name that differs beyond an initial, contact details that differ from the current ones or are missing, a loyalty or known-traveler number missing or differing from the records and a number the records leave out, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No ID name, no booked name, no statement of whether a date of birth is needed or no current contact details leave the details unverified. This reads one passenger’s booked details against the traveler’s records: a purchase receipt’s buyer identity against its delegation is wever_delegated-identity-check, a new agent’s identity at joining is wever_onboarding-identity-check and a vendor’s identity is wever_vendor-identity-check. Verdict travel_passenger_mismatched, travel_passenger_partial, travel_passenger_unverified or travel_passenger_matching. POST /api/travel-passenger-check. Reads the travel records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, booking or external write. Agent Travel reads a travel purchase an agent made, after the fact, from the traveler’s own records: the booking against the travel authorization, the itinerary against the trip as requested, the passenger details against the traveler’s ID, the fare rules against what the buyer was told, a change and a cancellation against the fare rules, the extras against what was authorized and needed, and a disruption against the carrier’s stated policy. Beside it, the Sports Trips tools such as wever_sports-trip-status plan, book and read a trip held on Wever, while a travel check reads a purchase made anywhere against its own records; wever_delegated-authority issues and reads the grant itself, while the authorization check reads one booking’s price, dates and class against the travel authorization behind it; and the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read a tokenized asset purchase, while a travel check reads a travel booking. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-travel-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-travel/.
